manifest.description: Everyday rewriting prompts. The AI runner arrives in Phase 3b.

prompts.title: Fix grammar
prompts.template:
Fix the grammar and spelling of this text. Keep the meaning and language ({{locale}}). Reply with only the corrected text:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Shorten
prompts.template:
Rewrite this text to be shorter and punchier, keeping all key points:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Make friendly
prompts.template:
Rewrite this text in a warm, friendly tone:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Make formal
prompts.template:
Rewrite this text in a formal, professional tone:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Summarize
prompts.template:
Summarize this text in two short bullet points:

{{text}}
